_about: Public holidays beyond data/holidays.json, used ONLY by the Business tools (working-day and deadline maths). holidays.json itself is left untouched because events.html depends on its exact shape. Only dates that are certain are listed: fixed-date holidays and Easter-based Christian holidays (computed). Lunar/announced holidays (Chinese New Year, Holi Phagwa, Ied-ul-Fitr, Ied-ul-Adha, Javaanse Nieuwjaar, Divali) are added only after official announcement; until then 'incomplete' makes the tools show a warning for that year.

2027.missing_note: Chinees Nieuwjaar, Holi Phagwa, Ied-Ul-Fitre, Ied-Ul-Adha, Javaanse Nieuwjaar en Divali 2027 zijn nog niet officieel bekendgemaakt.
